apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store apps to scrape. Use numeric ids (389801252), ids with prefix (id389801252), App Store URLs or bundle ids (com.duolingo.DuolingoMobile).

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter App Store country codes, for example us, gb, de.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app and country
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Apple's feed gives about 500 reviews at most for each app and country.

includeMetadata.title: Include app metadata
includeMetadata.description: Every review row already has the app fields (name, developer, bundle id, average stars, rating count, link). Turn this on with Max reviews set to 0 to get one app row for each app and country, for metadata-only runs. See the Apps view.

onlyNewReviews.title: Only new reviews
onlyNewReviews.description: Emit only reviews newer than the last run. The Actor keeps the state in the named key-value store appstore-reviews-state.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Optional name that keeps the saved state of this task apart from other tasks that track the same app. Use a different value for each task. Only used with Only new reviews.

sinceDate.title: Since date
sinceDate.description: Optional ISO date, for example 2026-01-01. Older reviews are skipped.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Order of the reviews. Most helpful needs no date order, so Only new reviews does not work with it.

minRating.title: Minimum stars
minRating.description: Optional. Keep only reviews with at least this many stars (1 to 5). Filtered-out reviews are not charged.

maxRating.title: Maximum stars
maxRating.description: Optional. Keep only reviews with at most this many stars (1 to 5). Filtered-out reviews are not charged.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Optional. Keep only reviews whose title or text has any of these words. Case does not matter. Filtered-out reviews are not charged.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use a proxy if Apple blocks the requests with HTTP 403. The default is no proxy.
